text:
mobile-agent-testers

 
 

 20 AI testers on 20 different phones, in parallel, on GitHub's free runners. 

 Examples · Compare · FAQ · Personas · Releases 

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Español · Português

No test scripts to write. Each tester is a Claude Code agent with its own iOS
Simulator or Android emulator on GitHub Actions. It plays a persona (iPhone SE
in Swedish at the largest text size, Pixel 7 at 200%, iPad in German, Arabic
right to left...), uses your app like a new user (or runs through the feature you
point it at) and writes a bug report with screenshots. Flutter, React Native, Expo, native Kotlin and Swift, Kotlin
Multiplatform, Capacitor and .NET MAUI.

GitHub's runners are free for public repos. You only pay for the model, with your
Claude subscription or API key: about $0.15 to $0.55 per phone in these runs.

 
 Real screen recordings of the LocalSend run, idle time cut. Full video (MP4) · The run, device by device 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 What it does

One use per run, set with the inputs of Test your own app.

- Explore like new users (the default). Each persona tries to reach its goal and reports what gets in the way, with numbered screenshots.
- Run one feature end to end. Your own brief sends every agent through a whole mechanic: a booking in several steps, an editor with undo, a sync between two screens. Agents tap, long press, swipe and type, leave the app and come back, relaunch it to check what was saved, or open a deep link to start right at the feature, and a brief can raise the budget of about 30 actions. AnkiDroid's found the Back field of a new card hidden behind the keyboard.
- Reproduce a bug report on every phone: give an issue or the steps, and each agent answers yes, no or unclear, with screenshots (briefs/reproduce.md).
- Get an improvement report. Each persona uses the app once, then says where it hesitated, what it expected and what to change first, by area and impact (briefs/improve.md).
- Compare two versions. The same personas on two branches or builds, then one table: goals reached, actions, scores, issues seen on one version only (docs/compare-versions.md). A check before a real A/B test, not a replacement for one.
- Use a cheaper model : Claude Haiku, or any Anthropic-compatible API (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, Qwen). The findings are only as good as the model's reading of screenshots and its reasoning (docs/cheaper-models.md).

 Applied examples

Real runs on open-source apps, with nothing planted.

 App Phones What the agents found Time, model usage 
 --- --- --- --- 
 LocalSend (Flutter, 100k stars) 20: 10 Android, 10 iOS, 14 languages 46 distinct bugs, 1 blocker: on an iPhone SE in Swedish at the largest text size, you can't send a text message at all 69 min, $4.62 
 AnkiDroid (Kotlin, 12k stars, release APK) 10 Android 43 distinct issues, among them answer buttons cut in half at 200% font and "Get started" left in English in three languages under 10 min, $4.69 
 Flutter's animations sample 1 Android, 1 iOS The same typo, reported by both agents on their own, and an app that ignores dark mode 19 min, $0.47 

34 of LocalSend's 46 bugs had nothing to do with text size or accessibility: broken flows, silent failures, missing translations, tablet layouts. Screenshots, every finding and the commands to run them again: docs/examples.md.

 Quick start

 

The demo app has 11 deliberate bugs. In one run, the 4 demo testers found 9 of them (2 to 7 minutes per agent, about 21 minutes for the whole run, builds included), plus real issues nobody planted (a button under the Android nav bar, no data kept after a relaunch). Model usage: $0.87 for the 4.

Or let Claude set it up for your app:

 

 Why not Maestro, Appium or agent-device?

They run the tests you write. These agents look for what nobody thought to test.

 mobile-agent-testers Maestro, Appium, Detox, e2e 
 --- --- --- 
 You write Nothing: pick personas from the list Flows or test code 
 It catches Broken flows, silent errors, missing translations, layout at large text, dark mode, confusing copy What each test checks 
 Same result every run No: each run explores, so check the screenshots Yes 

agent-device gives one coding agent hands on one simulator. This runs a whole session: it builds the app, gives each persona its own device and collects encrypted reports. Use agents before a release, and scripted flows for regressions.

Full comparison, with Firebase Test Lab Robo, mobile-mcp, phonedriver and human beta testers: docs/compare.md.

 Test your own app

 

 Input 
 --- --- 
 source repo , ref App repo and branch (empty = this repo). Private repo: add a read-only SOURCE REPO TOKEN secret 
 app dir , app id App folder, Android package / iOS bundle id (if the other platform uses another id, it is read from its built app) 
 android personas , ios personas Ids from personas.json, one phone each, all , or none to skip a platform. 20 ready: 14 languages, right to left, tablets, text from small to the largest accessibility size 
 brief Agent instructions: AGENT BRIEF.md to explore, briefs/improve.md for an improvement report, or your own for one feature 
 bug report A bug to reproduce instead of exploring: an issue ( owner/repo 123 or its URL) or the steps as text. Each agent follows it on its own device (briefs/reproduce.md) 
 model , llm base url sonnet by default, haiku to spend less, or any Anthropic-compatible API with its key in an LLM API KEY secret (docs/cheaper-models.md) 
 framework auto (default) or force one of the frameworks below 
 android build + apk path , ios build + ios app path Your own build command, or a download of a prebuilt app (paths relative to app dir ) 
 block hosts Analytics hosts blocked during tests 
 record video Screen recording of each phone, encrypted with the reports 

 Supported out of the box (detected automatically):

 Framework Android iOS Simulator 
 --- --- --- 
 Flutter flutter build apk --debug flutter build ios --simulator 
 React Native / Expo Gradle

install.title: Quick start
install.html:
gh repo create my-testers --public --template pierridotite/mobile-agent-testers --clone
cd my-testers && ./setup.sh           # key pair + secrets + Claude token (Windows: .\setup.ps1)
gh workflow run agent-testers.yml     # demo: 2 Android + 2 iOS testers, ~20 min
bash scripts/collect.sh <run id>      # decrypts reports, groups duplicates: runs/<id>/SUMMARY.md

The demo app has 11 deliberate bugs. In one run, the 4 demo testers found 9 of them (2 to 7 minutes per agent, about 21 minutes for the whole run, builds included), plus real issues nobody planted (a button under the Android nav bar, no data kept after a relaunch). Model usage: $0.87 for the 4.

Or let Claude set it up for your app:

/plugin marketplace add pierridotite/mobile-agent-testers
/plugin install mobile-agent-testers@mobile-agent-testers
